note: Cross-repo contract for the tmpx_ managed-model token. Terragram MINTS (src/features/billing/proxy.ts) and the EU gateway VERIFIES (infraweaver-proxy src/token.ts); the two share no code, so a fixture is the only thing that pins them. The gateway serves two products and every token carries a `product` claim: this copy carries "terragram", the gateway's own copy (and infraweaver-ui's) carries "infraweaver". Everything else is identical, and the sibling check compares everything except `product` and the token bytes it derives. The secret is a fixture value, never a real key.
